name: Attempt Recorder
description: Camera button in the pause menu: watch your last attempts (until death or win), switch between them and save as GIF to Downloads.

max-seconds.name: Max seconds per attempt
max-seconds.description: Only the last N seconds before death/win are kept.

max-attempts.name: Attempts to keep
max-attempts.description: How many recent attempts are stored in RAM.

frame-width.name: Recording width (px)
frame-width.description: Bigger = sharper but heavier on RAM/CPU.
